lessons.title: Un continente antes de Europa
lessons.goal: Read a continent-wide picture of the Americas before 1492, and talk about who lived there and what came before the Maya, Mexica and Inca.

lessons.title: Grandes civilizaciones
lessons.grammar: Se pasiva / impersonal, y voz pasiva
lessons.goal: Read about the Maya, Mexica and Inca in real depth, and talk about what made each distinctive.

lessons.title: Sociedad y poder
lessons.goal: Read how power, religion and social rank actually worked in Maya, Mexica and Inca society, and talk about what mobility looked like in each.

lessons.title: Vida cotidiana
lessons.goal: Read about everyday food, clothing and games before 1492, and explain a food-science trick Europe didn't understand for centuries.

lessons.title: Antes de la conquista
lessons.goal: Read how historians actually know what they know about the pre-Columbian world, from surviving Maya codices to a friar who copied down the Popol Vuh.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 1 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate the main pre-Columbian societies.

lessons.title: Los mayas
lessons.grammar: Voz pasiva y se pasiva en textos históricos
lessons.goal: Read in depth about Maya writing, mathematics and astronomy, and explain what recent evidence suggests about why southern cities were abandoned.

lessons.title: Los mexicas
lessons.goal: Read in depth about how the Mexica actually ran an empire, from the Triple Alliance to a temple rediscovered by accident, and explain why the scale of sacrifice is still debated.

lessons.title: Los incas
lessons.goal: Read in depth about how the Inca state functioned without writing or money, from knotted-cord records to a royal estate rediscovered in 1911.

lessons.title: Religión y conocimiento
lessons.grammar: Conectores formales: a lo largo de, a raíz de
lessons.goal: Read how religion and knowledge were the same profession across the Inca, Maya and Mexica worlds, and explain how a lost medical manuscript resurfaced centuries later.

lessons.title: Un legado vivo
lessons.grammar: Voz pasiva para hablar del legado
lessons.goal: Read how indigenous languages shaped everyday vocabulary and how a single Andean crop changed European demographic history, and explain what legal recognition of indigenous languages does and doesn't guarantee.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 2 Consolidation
lessons.grammar: consolidation of Indigenous civilisations, social organisation, knowledge and living legacies
lessons.goal: Review Indigenous civilisations, social organisation, knowledge and living legacies.

lessons.title: El viaje de Colón
lessons.grammar: Narración histórica: pretérito indefinido e imperfecto
lessons.goal: Read the real story of Columbus's 1492 voyage, from the Reconquista's end to why the continent was named after someone else entirely.

lessons.title: El encuentro
lessons.grammar: Secuencia y contraste: mientras, cuando, al principio, después
lessons.goal: Read how first contact with the Taíno turned from peaceful exchange to forced labor and demographic collapse within a generation, and meet the friar who later condemned it in print.

lessons.title: Conquista y resistencia
lessons.grammar: Construcciones con se e interpretación de agentes
lessons.goal: Read about two Caribbean resistance leaders a generation apart, one executed for refusing baptism and one whose revolt forced the Spanish crown to the negotiating table.

lessons.title: Nuevos mundos
lessons.grammar: Causa y consecuencia: debido a, por eso, por lo tanto, como consecuencia
lessons.goal: Read about the Columbian Exchange in both directions, from sugarcane's link to the slave trade to a debated theory connecting American demographic collapse and global climate.

lessons.title: Una transformación histórica
lessons.grammar: Oraciones de relativo para precisar información histórica
lessons.goal: Read why historians can't agree on a single word for 1492 or on how many people lived in the Americas before it, and explain what the Virgin of Guadalupe reveals about cultural blending.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 3 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Review arrival, encounter, conquest and resistance, and the long-term consequences of European expansion.

lessons.title: La conquista de México
lessons.goal: Read how Tenochtitlan actually fell: an alliance with the Mexica's own enemies, a smallpox epidemic that killed an emperor, and a two-year campaign rather than an overnight collapse.

lessons.title: La conquista del Perú
lessons.goal: Read how fewer than 200 Spaniards captured an empire in crisis, from the Cajamarca ambush to a resistance state that survived four decades longer than most people assume.

lessons.title: Alianzas y conflictos
lessons.goal: Read why the conquest was fought mostly by indigenous soldiers, meet the woman whose translation made it possible, and learn what one ally negotiated for centuries afterward.

lessons.title: Violencia y poder
lessons.goal: Read about the mechanisms behind the conquest beyond swords and horses: a massacre used to intimidate, a legal document nobody understood, and how fast indigenous armies adapted.

lessons.title: ¿Conquista o catástrofe?
lessons.goal: Read why most conquest accounts were written by the winning side, meet the 20th-century work that gathered rare indigenous testimony, and learn why battle deaths were a fraction of the real toll.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 4 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Review conquest, alliances, violence and historical interpretation.

lessons.title: El imperio español
lessons.goal: Read how Spain actually governed an empire an ocean away: viceroyalties that kept splitting, a trade monopoly run from one city, and a legal loophole for ignoring royal orders.

lessons.title: Una sociedad jerárquica
lessons.goal: Read how the colonial hierarchy was written directly into law, from two parallel legal systems to a grievance that quietly built for three centuries.

lessons.title: La Iglesia
lessons.goal: Read how the Church functioned as the colony's real infrastructure, from early universities to self-governing Jesuit missions and an Inquisition that couldn't prosecute indigenous people.

lessons.title: La vida cotidiana
lessons.goal: Read how colonial cities were literally designed by royal decree, how markets blurred official legal separation, and the bishop who reportedly paid with his life for banning chocolate.

lessons.title: Vivir en la colonia
lessons.goal: Read a synthesis of nearly three centuries of colonial life — longer than most of these countries have existed as independent states — and what actually held the system together.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 5 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Review colonial society, hierarchy, religion and administration.

lessons.title: Plata y oro
lessons.grammar: Voz pasiva: extracción de plata y oro
lessons.goal: Read how one Andean mountain funded a global empire: a boomtown that rivaled London, a toxic extraction method, and coins that circulated as far as Ming China.

lessons.title: Trabajo y explotación
lessons.grammar: Se pasivo: sistemas de trabajo colonial
lessons.goal: Read about three distinct colonial labor systems, and the formal royal debate in Spain over whether indigenous people had full rights as human beings.

lessons.title: Plantaciones
lessons.goal: Read about the plantation economy behind the mines: an early industrial-scale sugar mill, why Brazil received more enslaved Africans than anywhere else, and the cacao fortune behind a famous independence name.

lessons.title: Comercio imperial
lessons.goal: Read about the convoy system built to protect Spain's silver from pirates, the contraband trade that may have rivaled it, and the annual voyage that first connected Asia and the Americas.

lessons.title: El precio del imperio
lessons.grammar: Voz pasiva: consecuencias de la economía colonial
lessons.goal: Read the paradox at the center of the colonial economy: the empire that received the most silver in world history arguably paid for it with its own long-term decline, while wealth stayed concentrated in very few hands.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 6 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate extraction, labour, plantations and imperial trade.

lessons.title: Una sociedad de castas
lessons.grammar: Se pasiva / impersonal: la sociedad de castas
lessons.goal: Read about the elaborate colonial racial-classification system and the strange 18th-century painting genre that tried to make it look orderly.

lessons.title: Peninsulares y criollos
lessons.goal: Read how criollos briefly bought their way into power under the Habsburgs, and how the Bourbon reforms deliberately closed that door, turning a slow grievance into an acute one.

lessons.title: Indígenas y afrodescendientes
lessons.grammar: Gerundio: posición social indígena y afrodescendiente
lessons.goal: Read about two very different colonial legal frameworks: a paternalistic 'legal minor' doctrine for indigenous people, and free Black militias and an escaped-slave town still standing today.

lessons.title: Mezcla y desigualdad
lessons.goal: Read about a demographic reality the racial hierarchy couldn't keep up with, and the genuinely bizarre 1795 decree that let wealthy mixed-race people legally purchase reclassification as 'white'.

lessons.title: Herencias coloniales
lessons.grammar: Voz pasiva: herencias de la jerarquía colonial
lessons.goal: Read why the castas were abolished within years of independence, yet the inequality they described kept showing up statistically for generations afterward.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 7 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate race, class, hierarchy and colonial legacies.

lessons.title: El mundo cambia
lessons.goal: Read what actually triggered Latin American independence: not simply accumulated resentment, but a specific 1808 crisis in Spain, plus a nearby revolution that inspired and terrified in equal measure.

lessons.title: Las guerras de independencia
lessons.goal: Read how the wars of independence actually unfolded: over a decade of fighting, early leaders executed, and conflicts that split communities as much as they split colonies from Spain.

lessons.title: Bolívar y San Martín
lessons.goal: Read about two independence campaigns converging from opposite directions, an Andes crossing compared to Hannibal's, and the still-mysterious 1822 meeting after which one man walked away from politics for good.

lessons.title: Nuevas repúblicas
lessons.goal: Read why winning independence turned out to be the easy part: wrecked economies, almost no local administrative experience, and a London lending bubble that collapsed within years.

lessons.title: ¿Independencia para quién?
lessons.goal: Read who actually benefited from independence: citizenship was proclaimed equal for free men, but slavery mostly wasn't abolished, indigenous land protections were weakened, and no woman gained the vote.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 8 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate independence, revolution, republicanism and political change.

lessons.title: Construir un Estado
lessons.goal: Read what building a state from nothing actually required, and how the federal experiment in Central America collapsed into five separate countries within eighteen years.

lessons.title: Fronteras y territorios
lessons.goal: Read about the legal principle meant to prevent border wars by freezing old colonial lines, and why it mostly failed since much of the interior had never been surveyed.

lessons.title: Liberales y conservadores
lessons.goal: Read what liberals and conservatives actually fought over — the Church's property, communal land, and how many times one country rewrote its own constitution.

lessons.title: Inestabilidad política
lessons.goal: Read about a specific term for a specific kind of coup, and the country whose 19th-century government changed hands so often historians still argue over the exact count.

lessons.title: Los primeros desafíos
lessons.goal: Read a synthesis of the unit's four challenges — state-building, borders, ideological war, instability — and why, despite it all, institutions slowly took shape.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 9 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate state formation, territorial organisation, ideological divisions and early republican instability.

lessons.title: El caudillo
lessons.goal: Read about what a caudillo actually was, through Juan Manuel de Rosas — near-absolute legal power, a secret police, and colored ribbons that marked who could be trusted.

lessons.title: Poder personal
lessons.goal: Read how a caudillo's power actually worked day to day, through José Antonio Páez — a personal network of favors and loyalty, not a bureaucracy.

lessons.title: Ejército y política
lessons.goal: Read how military command and political power fused into one thing, through a caudillo who led thousands of irregular cavalry without ever holding formal rank.

lessons.title: Orden o inestabilidad
lessons.goal: Read about the book that framed caudillos as pure barbarism, and the indigenous-backed caudillo whose case doesn't fit that framing at all.

lessons.title: El legado del caudillismo
lessons.goal: Read a synthesis of what caudillismo actually left behind — not a single legacy, but sharply different outcomes depending on which country you look at.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 10 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate caudillismo, patronage, military power and political instability.

lessons.title: ¿Qué es una nación?
lessons.goal: Read why a nation isn't the same thing as a state or a territory, through the idea of 'imagined communities' — and why most members of any nation will never meet.

lessons.title: Símbolos nacionales
lessons.goal: Read how flags and anthems were actually made: a general who improvised a flag in 1812, and a national anthem chosen by public competition decades after independence.

lessons.title: Crear una identidad
lessons.goal: Read about the contradiction at the heart of 19th-century nation-building: celebrating Aztec imagery as a symbol while pursuing policies hostile to living indigenous communities.

lessons.title: Pueblos y fronteras
lessons.goal: Read how new national borders cut straight through communities that had never organized themselves that way — the Aymara people, split across three countries, being the clearest case.

lessons.title: Imaginar la nación
lessons.goal: Read a closing thesis on nationalism: neither an eternal truth nor a simple lie, but a real historical invention with real consequences.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 11 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate nation, nationalism, identity and state-building.

lessons.title: Las ideas liberales
lessons.goal: Read about the liberal creed of equal citizenship, and the property and literacy requirements that quietly excluded most of the population from actually voting.

lessons.title: Reformar el Estado
lessons.goal: Read how liberal governments took birth, marriage and death records out of Church hands, why the change was controversial in Mexico's 1855-1863 Reform Laws, and what conflict it triggered.

lessons.title: Iglesia y Estado
lessons.goal: Read how Colombia and Ecuador took the opposite path from Mexico, strengthening rather than weakening Church power for decades, and when each finally moved toward a secular state.

lessons.title: Modernizar la sociedad
lessons.goal: Read how railroads and telegraph lines were built to connect export zones to ports rather than the interior, and how positivism's "order and progress" justified the process.

lessons.title: Un nuevo modelo
lessons.goal: Read a balanced synthesis of the liberal era's real gains and real limits, and understand why historians describe it as several divergent national projects rather than one.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 12 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate language for liberalism, institutional reform, secularisation and modernisation.

lessons.title: El modelo exportador
lessons.goal: Read how the post-independence export model differed from colonial mercantilism, how countries specialized in one or two products, and why the model was profitable but vulnerable.

lessons.title: Productos y materias primas
lessons.goal: Read a country-by-country tour of what each Latin American economy exported in the late nineteenth century, including the 1876 refrigeration breakthrough that let Argentina start exporting meat.

lessons.title: Ferrocarriles, puertos y mercados
lessons.goal: Read how foreign-owned railways, ports and companies formed "enclave economies" -- and how a British businessman came to influence Chilean politics without ever holding office.

lessons.title: Trabajo, tierra y desigualdad
lessons.goal: Read how the export boom's labor needs were met -- debt peonage tied to land privatization in some regions, mass European immigration in others -- and how land ownership concentrated by 1900.

lessons.title: Dependencia y vulnerabilidad
lessons.goal: Read Peru's guano boom and bust as a case study in what single-commodity dependency costs, and understand why the region's export vulnerability was structural rather than accidental.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 13 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate export economies, international markets, infrastructure, inequality and dependency.

lessons.title: Nuevas ciudades
lessons.grammar: Imperfecto: describir cómo era la ciudad antes
lessons.goal: Read how Buenos Aires and Mexico City transformed from colonial-looking towns into Paris-inspired capitals in a couple of decades -- and who that modernization actually reached.

lessons.title: Nuevas clases sociales
lessons.grammar: Subjuntivo de duda: no está claro que...
lessons.goal: Read how a new urban middle class and working class emerged alongside the old landed oligarchy, and why historians doubt these groups formed as clear an identity as it might seem.

lessons.title: Inmigración
lessons.goal: Read how Argentina's "gobernar es poblar" policy drew roughly six million European immigrants between 1880 and 1930, and how they organized mutual aid societies and lived in crowded conventillos.

lessons.title: Trabajo y conflicto
lessons.grammar: Subjuntivo con conjunciones temporales: cuando, hasta que, antes de que
lessons.goal: Read how immigrant political ideas fed labor organizing in Argentina and Chile, Argentina's 1902 deportation law, and the 1907 Santa María School massacre of striking nitrate workers.

lessons.title: Una sociedad en transformación
lessons.grammar: Correlativos formales: no solo... sino también
lessons.goal: Read a closing synthesis of how modernization ran at two speeds -- dazzling change in the cities, almost none in much of the countryside -- and why "modernization" needs to specify for whom.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 14 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate urbanisation, migration, social class and labour movements.

lessons.title: ¿Qué es una revolución?
lessons.grammar: No es lo mismo... que: distinciones conceptuales
lessons.goal: Read the distinction between a political coup and a genuine social revolution, and understand why the Haitian Revolution (1791-1804) was likely the hemisphere's first true social revolution.

lessons.title: Tierra y poder
lessons.grammar: Conectores causales: debido a que, a causa de que
lessons.goal: Read how land concentration from the export-era latifundio became the region's central source of social tension, and why land became the most widespread revolutionary demand on the continent.

lessons.title: Trabajadores y movimientos sociales
lessons.grammar: Sin que + subjuntivo: lo que no llegó a ocurrir
lessons.goal: Read about the urban labor movement as a second revolutionary current alongside rural land conflict, and why the two rarely managed to form a lasting alliance.

lessons.title: Revolución y Estado
lessons.grammar: Futuro simple: predicciones sobre lo que vendrá
lessons.goal: Read why building a functioning state after a revolutionary victory is often harder than winning it, and why that phase can turn out more violent than the struggle for power itself.

lessons.title: Cuando cambia el orden
lessons.goal: Read a closing synthesis of what jointly precedes a genuine revolution -- land concentration, organized labor, a weakened state, and coordinated opposition -- as the unit sets up the Mexican Revolution.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 15 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate revolution, mobilisation, land and political change.

lessons.title: El Porfiriato
lessons.grammar: Llevar + gerundio: cuánto tiempo llevaba ocurriendo algo
lessons.goal: Read how Porfirio Díaz's 34-year rule combined real economic modernization with extreme land concentration and "pan o palo" repression, and what triggered the 1910 crisis.

lessons.title: Madero y la revolución
lessons.grammar: Subjuntivo tras verbos de petición: pedir que, exigir que
lessons.goal: Read how Francisco Madero's Plan de San Luis Potosí triggered the uprising that ended Díaz's 34-year rule, and how Madero's caution as president sowed the seeds of new conflict.

lessons.title: Zapata y Villa
lessons.grammar: El hecho de que + subjuntivo: nominalizar una idea
lessons.goal: Read about Zapata's land-focused Plan de Ayala in the south, Villa's northern División del Norte, and their brief, ultimately fragile 1914 alliance.

lessons.title: La Constitución de 1917
lessons.goal: Read what made Mexico's 1917 Constitution radical for its era -- Article 27 on land and subsoil, Article 123 on labor rights -- and how it differed from earlier liberal constitutions.

lessons.title: El legado revolucionario
lessons.grammar: No tanto... como: matizar una comparación
lessons.goal: Read a closing account of the revolution's human cost, the PRI's seventy-year rule as its main institutional legacy, and how that stability came at the cost of one-party dominance.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 16 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate the Mexican Revolution, land, revolution and state-building.

lessons.title: Estados más fuertes
lessons.grammar: Pretérito perfecto compuesto: lo que los Estados han logrado
lessons.goal: Read how early twentieth-century Latin American states professionalized their armies, built real tax systems, and expanded bureaucratic reach beyond the nineteenth century's chronic weakness.

lessons.title: Nacionalismo cultural
lessons.grammar: A pesar de que + subjuntivo: una contradicción reconocida
lessons.goal: Read how Mexican muralism and indigenismo celebrated the indigenous past while living indigenous communities remained marginalized, and how similar cultural-nationalist movements arose across the region.

lessons.title: Educación y nación
lessons.grammar: Futuro perfecto: conjeturas sobre lo ya ocurrido
lessons.goal: Read how Vasconcelos's rural "misiones culturales" used teachers and new schools to extend national language and identity into remote regions, funded by the new tax system.

lessons.title: Poblaciones y territorios
lessons.grammar: Ya no: marcar el fin de una situación anterior
lessons.goal: Read how censuses, conscription, and locally-imposed authorities integrated once-autonomous rural regions into the reach of the national state for the first time.

lessons.title: El Estado moderno
lessons.grammar: A medida que: procesos que avanzan juntos
lessons.goal: Read a closing synthesis of how institutional strengthening, cultural nationalism, education, and territorial integration advanced together to produce a categorically different, modern Latin American state.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 17 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate nationalism, state-building, education and citizenship.

lessons.title: La crisis de 1929
lessons.goal: Read how the October 1929 Wall Street crash triggered bank runs, mass unemployment, and a collapse in American lending that would soon reach economies worldwide.

lessons.title: América Latina y la crisis
lessons.goal: Read how collapsing commodity demand and drying-up foreign lending proved the export model's structural vulnerability true, and why Chile was among the hardest-hit countries in the world.

lessons.title: Menos comercio, menos ingresos
lessons.goal: Read how the trade collapse became a fiscal crisis for customs-dependent Latin American states, leaving newly built armies and rural schools unfunded.

lessons.title: Cambiar el modelo económico
lessons.goal: Read how the crisis pushed governments toward import substitution industrialization -- tariff barriers, state investment in strategic industries -- as a deliberate break from the export model.

lessons.title: Una crisis que transformó la región
lessons.goal: Read a closing synthesis of why 1929 counts as a genuine turning point -- proving the export model's limits, opening space for new political leadership, and cementing import substitution as the region's new economic norm.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 18 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate language for the Great Depression, Latin American exports, trade, industrialisation and changing state intervention.

lessons.title: ¿Qué es el populismo?
lessons.grammar: Se suele + infinitivo: describir un patrón general
lessons.goal: Read how Latin American populism is typically defined, its common features, and the ongoing scholarly debate over whether it's a style, an ideology, or a strategy.

lessons.title: Perón y Argentina
lessons.grammar: Tanto es así que: reforzar una afirmación
lessons.goal: Read how Juan Domingo Perón built a labor-based political movement from a minor government post, Evita's independent influence, and the enduring debate over Peronism's legacy.

lessons.title: Cárdenas y México
lessons.grammar: A diferencia de: comparar dos casos
lessons.goal: Read how Lázaro Cárdenas's austere style, peasant-based reform, and 1938 oil nationalization contrast with Perón's populism, and why his legacy is far less divisive in Mexico.

lessons.title: Pueblo y líder
lessons.grammar: Subjuntivo de valoración: es cuestionable que
lessons.goal: Read a critical look at populism's central mechanism -- the direct leader-people bond, who "the people" actually excludes, and radio's role -- alongside what this bond genuinely meant for millions.

lessons.title: El legado populista
lessons.grammar: Si bien... también es cierto que: un balance equilibrado
lessons.goal: Read a balanced closing verdict on populism's legacy -- real material gains alongside weakened democratic institutions -- and how its influence outlasted the leaders themselves.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 19 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate populism, leadership, workers and political mobilisation.

lessons.title: Producir en casa
lessons.grammar: No fue hasta que: precisar cuándo ocurrió algo
lessons.goal: Read how World War II, not the 1929 crisis alone, forced import substitution to become the region's dominant economic model -- and why governments deepened it after the war rather than abandoning it.

lessons.title: Nuevas industrias
lessons.grammar: Por parte de: atribuir la acción en construcciones formales
lessons.goal: Read how governments moved from protecting private industry with tariffs to directly building state-owned steel mills, hydroelectric plants, and eventually automobile assembly across the region.

lessons.title: Migración a las ciudades
lessons.grammar: No dejar de + infinitivo: un proceso que no se detiene
lessons.goal: Read how factory jobs pulled millions from the countryside into cities that couldn't build infrastructure fast enough, producing favelas, villas miseria, and barriadas across the region.

lessons.title: Nuevas sociedades urbanas
lessons.grammar: Por más que + subjuntivo: una desigualdad persistente
lessons.goal: Read how urbanization produced a growing informal economy alongside formal jobs, persistent wage gaps for working women, and an early consumer culture that didn't erase old inequalities.

lessons.title: Un continente industrial
lessons.grammar: Pese a que + subjuntivo: un logro con límites
lessons.goal: Read a closing balance of import substitution's real achievement by the 1960s against its structural limits -- imported-technology dependence, uneven regional development, and growing foreign debt.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 20 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate industrialisation, urbanisation, migration and development.

lessons.title: Cuba antes de 1959
lessons.grammar: Lejos de + infinitivo: corregir una idea equivocada
lessons.goal: Read how pre-revolutionary Cuba combined a relatively high per-capita income with deep inequality, near-total US economic dependence, and Batista's unpopular dictatorship.

lessons.title: Fidel Castro y la revolución
lessons.grammar: Acabar por + infinitivo: cómo terminó un proceso
lessons.goal: Read how the 1953 Moncada attack, the 1956 Granma landing, and two years of guerrilla war in the Sierra Maestra ended up toppling Batista on January 1, 1959.

lessons.title: Una revolución socialista
lessons.grammar: Cada vez menos... cada vez más: describir una radicalización
lessons.goal: Read how Cuba's government radicalized month by month -- nationalizing US-owned businesses, drawing closer to the USSR, and declaring itself socialist in April 1961.

lessons.title: Bahía de Cochinos y misiles
lessons.grammar: A punto de + infinitivo: al borde de que algo ocurra
lessons.goal: Read how the failed 1961 Bay of Pigs invasion and the October 1962 Missile Crisis brought the world closer to nuclear war than at any other moment in the Cold War.

lessons.title: Cuba y América Latina
lessons.grammar: No por... deja de: matizar sin negar del todo
lessons.goal: Read how Cuba inspired guerrilla movements across the region via Che Guevara's "foco" theory, how the US responded, and why Cuba's shadow shaped Latin American politics for three decades.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 21 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate the Cuban Revolution, socialism, Cold War and regional influence.

lessons.title: Dos bloques
lessons.grammar: Ya sea... ya sea: presentar dos opciones formales
lessons.goal: Read how the post-1945 world split into US-led and Soviet-led blocs, the containment doctrine, and the nuclear arms race, and why Latin America became a particularly sensitive Cold War terrain.

lessons.title: América Latina en la Guerra Fría
lessons.grammar: Con tal de que + subjuntivo: una condición explícita
lessons.goal: Read how Kennedy's 1961 Alliance for Progress offered aid conditioned on moderate reform and anti-communist alignment, and why its results varied so much across the region.

lessons.title: Revolución o anticomunismo
lessons.grammar: No cabe duda de que: afirmar con seguridad
lessons.goal: Read how Cold War logic polarized Latin American politics into revolution versus anticommunism, the military's National Security Doctrine, and the radicalization it triggered on the left.

lessons.title: Intervención extranjera
lessons.grammar: So pretexto de: una justificación oficial cuestionable
lessons.goal: Read how both superpowers intervened directly in Latin America -- the 1954 CIA-backed coup in Guatemala, the 1965 US intervention in the Dominican Republic, and Soviet-Cuban support for guerrillas.

lessons.title: Un continente dividido
lessons.grammar: No hay + sustantivo + que no: una afirmación universal
lessons.goal: Read a closing synthesis of how thoroughly Cold War polarization touched universities, unions and militaries across Latin America, setting up the coups and repression to come.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 22 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate Cold War, ideology, intervention and conflict.

lessons.title: El vecino del norte
lessons.grammar: Tan... como: comparar poder y tamaño
lessons.goal: Read how the 1823 Monroe Doctrine evolved from a defense of Latin American independence into a claimed US right to intervene, and the deep, mutual asymmetry that shaped the relationship.

lessons.title: Intervenciones
lessons.grammar: Mientras tanto: dos historias que ocurren a la vez
lessons.goal: Read how the 1904 Roosevelt Corollary justified direct US occupations of Haiti, the Dominican Republic, and Nicaragua, and how Panama's 1903 independence was tied to the Panama Canal -- all decades before the Cold War.

lessons.title: Economía y dependencia
lessons.grammar: Cuanto más... (tanto) más: relaciones que crecen juntas
lessons.goal: Read how dollar diplomacy, US corporate control of key industries, and foreign debt created a form of economic dependency that often didn't require troops or formal occupation.

lessons.title: Alianza para el Progreso
lessons.grammar: A raíz de: el origen de un cambio
lessons.goal: Read the concrete numbers, country-by-country results, and quiet early-1970s wind-down of the Alliance for Progress, beyond its 1961 launch.

lessons.title: Una relación compleja
lessons.grammar: Así como: comparar y sumar elementos paralelos
lessons.goal: Read a closing synthesis of the unit: intervention and economic dependency were real, but so were migration, cultural exchange, and mutual influence.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 23 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate US regional influence, intervention, economic relations and policy responses.

lessons.title: Los golpes de Estado
lessons.grammar: Más bien: matizar en vez de simplemente contrastar
lessons.goal: Read how the 1964-1976 wave of military coups produced a distinctly institutional kind of authoritarian rule, and O'Donnell's concept of the bureaucratic-authoritarian state.

lessons.title: Brasil
lessons.grammar: De tal manera que: describir un resultado
lessons.goal: Read how Brazil's 1964 coup produced two decades of Institutional Acts and escalating censorship alongside a rapid "economic miracle", ending in a gradual return to civilian rule by 1985.

lessons.title: Chile
lessons.grammar: Tras: indicar lo que viene después
lessons.goal: Read how the 1973 coup against Allende ended in his death and Pinochet's seventeen-year rule, and how the regime's free-market "Chicago Boys" experiment outlasted the dictatorship itself.

lessons.title: Argentina
lessons.goal: Read how Argentina's 1976 coup and its "National Reorganization Process" promised order and modernization, but ended in debt, deindustrialization, and a lost war that forced the return to elections in 1983.

lessons.title: El poder militar
lessons.goal: Read a closing comparison of Brazil, Chile, and Argentina's military governments, plus Uruguay, Bolivia, and Paraguay, and why nearly every one of them eventually gave way.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 24 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate coups, military governments and authoritarianism.

lessons.title: El Estado represivo
lessons.grammar: En virtud de: la base legal de una acción
lessons.goal: Read how the region's military governments dressed repression in a legal facade -- states of siege, dedicated intelligence agencies, and clandestine detention centers.

lessons.title: Censura y persecución
lessons.grammar: Con el fin de: expresar un propósito
lessons.goal: Read how these regimes' quieter, everyday campaign against expression worked -- press censorship, book burning, blacklists, university purges, and exile.

lessons.title: Desaparecidos
lessons.grammar: Aun cuando: una concesión más fuerte que aunque
lessons.goal: Read how enforced disappearance worked as a deliberate method, the disputed scale of it in Argentina, and how the Mothers of Plaza de Mayo turned grief into a lasting form of resistance.

lessons.title: Resistencia
lessons.grammar: Cabe destacar que: señalar un dato importante
lessons.goal: Read how resistance to repression took many forms -- human rights organizations, Pérez Esquivel's 1980 Nobel Peace Prize, cultural resistance, and international solidarity, alongside a smaller armed resistance.

lessons.title: Memoria y justicia
lessons.grammar: A día de hoy: hablar de la situación actual
lessons.goal: Read how these countries tried, imperfectly and unevenly, to reckon with the past -- Argentina's 1985 Juicio a las Juntas, its later amnesty laws and their 2003-2005 annulment, and memory sites like the former ESMA.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 25 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate repression, censorship, disappearance, resistance and memory.

lessons.title: Nicaragua
lessons.grammar: Una vez que: marcar el punto de partida de algo nuevo
lessons.goal: Read how forty-three years of Somoza family rule ended in July 1979, when the Sandinista Front finally overthrew the dynasty in the region's last successful armed revolution of the century.

lessons.title: El Salvador
lessons.grammar: Al cabo de: el tiempo transcurrido
lessons.goal: Read how Archbishop Romero's March 1980 assassination opened a twelve-year civil war between the US-backed army and the FMLN, including the December 1981 El Mozote massacre.

lessons.title: Guatemala
lessons.grammar: De ahí en adelante: continuar una narración desde un punto
lessons.goal: Read how the internal armed conflict that followed the 1954 coup dragged on for thirty-six years, including the 1981-1983 scorched-earth campaigns a UN-backed commission later found constituted genocide.

lessons.title: Intervención y Guerra Fría
lessons.grammar: A instancias de: señalar quién impulsó una acción
lessons.goal: Read how all three conflicts became Cold War proxy wars -- the Contra war, the Iran-Contra scandal, the 1986 World Court ruling against the US, and Cuban/Soviet support for guerrillas in El Salvador and Guatemala.

lessons.title: Los Acuerdos de Paz
lessons.grammar: No sin antes: reconocer un paso previo necesario
lessons.goal: Read how Nicaragua's 1990 elections, El Salvador's 1992 Chapultepec Accords, and Guatemala's 1996 Peace Accords each ended these wars through negotiation, not military victory -- and what those settlements left unresolved.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 26 Consolidation
lessons.grammar: consolidation of revolution, conflict, intervention and peace
lessons.goal: Consolidate revolution, civil conflict, intervention and peace-building.

lessons.title: Chile
lessons.goal: Read about DINA's clandestine detention network at Villa Grimaldi, and the unexpected 1988 plebiscite that ended Pinochet's seventeen years in power -- not the 1973 coup, already covered.

lessons.title: Argentina
lessons.goal: Read about the internal succession of Argentina's military juntas (Videla, Viola, Galtieri, Bignone) and how Galtieri's 1982 Falklands gamble finally brought the regime down -- not the coup or the disappearances, already covered.

lessons.title: Uruguay
lessons.goal: Read how President Bordaberry's 1973 self-coup led to a twelve-year dictatorship with one of the world's highest per-capita rates of political prisoners, and how a rejected 1980 constitution set an early path back to democracy.

lessons.title: Operación Cóndor
lessons.goal: Read how the Southern Cone dictatorships built a coordinated transnational network to hunt exiled dissidents across borders, including the 1976 assassination of Orlando Letelier in Washington, DC, and the 1992 discovery of the Terror Archives.

lessons.title: Democracia y memoria
lessons.goal: Read a closing comparison of how Argentina, Chile, and Uruguay each confronted their dictatorships' legacies differently -- early trials, truth commissions (Rettig, Valech), and Uruguay's unique amnesty-by-referendum pattern.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 27 Consolidation
lessons.grammar: consolidation of dictatorship, repression, coordination, memory and democracy
lessons.goal: Consolidate dictatorship, repression, coordination, memory and democracy.

lessons.title: La deuda crece
lessons.goal: Read how the 1970s oil shocks flooded international banks with petrodollars, which they lent heavily to Latin American governments at variable rates -- leaving the region dangerously exposed by 1982.

lessons.title: La crisis de 1982
lessons.goal: Read how the US Federal Reserve's interest rate hikes under Volcker made Latin American debt suddenly unpayable, and how Mexico's August 1982 default announcement triggered a region-wide domino effect.

lessons.title: Austeridad
lessons.goal: Read how IMF-backed structural adjustment programs attached conditions -- spending cuts, devaluation, trade liberalization -- to emergency loans, and the sovereignty debate this sparked across the region.

lessons.title: El coste social
lessons.goal: Read how spending cuts and inflation eroded real wages and fueled the informal sector and rising poverty across the 1980s, including Venezuela's deadly February 1989 Caracazo riots.

lessons.title: Una década perdida
lessons.goal: Read why the 1980s became known as Latin America's "lost decade" -- near-zero per capita growth, a debt that kept growing anyway, and the 1989 Brady Plan that finally marked its formal end.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 28 Consolidation
lessons.grammar: debt, adjustment, social consequences and historical synthesis
lessons.goal: Consolidate the main causes, responses and consequences of the Latin American debt crisis.

lessons.title: Las ideas neoliberales
lessons.goal: Read how the 1989 Washington Consensus formalized ten market-reform prescriptions that most 1990s Latin American governments adopted after the lost decade, building on Chile's earlier Chicago Boys precedent.

lessons.title: Privatización
lessons.goal: Read how Argentina under Menem and Mexico under Salinas privatized major state enterprises in the early 1990s -- and the efficiency arguments for it and the corruption and job-loss controversies against it.

lessons.title: El mercado y el Estado
lessons.goal: Read how 1990s reforms flipped the state's role from planner and owner (under ISI) to a market-driven model with lower tariffs, independent central banks, and active courting of foreign investment.

lessons.title: Desigualdad y pobreza
lessons.goal: Read how 1990s macroeconomic recovery -- lower inflation, renewed growth -- coexisted with persistent or worsening inequality, ECLAC's "growth without equity" critique, and Latin America's world-leading Gini coefficients.

lessons.title: El legado neoliberal
lessons.goal: Read a closing, balanced assessment of the neoliberal decade -- the hyperinflation-taming success of Argentina's 1991 Convertibility Plan and Brazil's 1994 Plano Real, against the structural fragility that contributed to Argentina's 2001 collapse.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 29 Consolidation
lessons.grammar: reform, competition, social consequences and historical síntesis
lessons.goal: Consolidate the main causes, responses and consequences of the Latin American neoliberal reforms.

lessons.title: Volver a votar
lessons.goal: Read how, one after another between 1979 and 1990, Latin American countries returned to elected civilian government -- through collapse, negotiation, or Paraguay's own internal coup against Stroessner.

lessons.title: Nuevas instituciones
lessons.goal: Read how new democracies wrote entirely new constitutions -- Brazil's 1988 "Citizen Constitution", Colombia's 1991 charter and Constitutional Court, and Paraguay's 1992 post-Stroessner constitution -- plus the region-wide rise of independent electoral tribunals.

lessons.title: Democracia y justicia
lessons.goal: Read how Brazil took a starkly different path from Argentina or Chile -- a 1979 self-amnesty upheld by its own Supreme Court in 2010, the same year the Inter-American Court ruled it incompatible with international law.

lessons.title: Las dificultades de la transición
lessons.goal: Read how Guatemala's failed 1993 "serranazo" self-coup showed the region's changed response to such attempts, plus the institutional and economic constraints young democracies inherited from the dictatorships and the debt crisis.

lessons.title: Democracias imperfectas
lessons.goal: Read a closing assessment of these new democracies through O'Donnell's 1994 "delegative democracy" concept -- periodic clean elections alongside weak accountability, corruption, and persistently low institutional trust.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 30 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate language for democratic transitions, institutions, justice, political challenges and evaluation.

lessons.title: Pueblos indígenas
lessons.goal: Read about Latin America's more than forty million Indigenous people across hundreds of distinct peoples and languages, and the near-total lack of official recognition most states gave them for most of the twentieth century.

lessons.title: Tierra y derechos
lessons.goal: Read how the 1989 ILO Convention 169 gave Indigenous movements a key legal tool for land rights, alongside Nicaragua's 1987 Atlantic Coast autonomous regions and Colombia's resguardo system.

lessons.title: Identidad y reconocimiento
lessons.goal: Read how constitutions across the region stopped treating themselves as culturally uniform -- Colombia 1991, Mexico's 1992 reform, Ecuador's 2008 "Buen Vivir", and Bolivia's 2009 Plurinational State.

lessons.title: Movilización política

lessons.goal: Consolidate language for Indigenous identity, land, rights, political mobilisation and contemporary representation.

lessons.title: ¿Por qué integrarse?

lessons.title: Mercosur

lessons.title: Comunidad Andina
lessons.goal: Read how the 1969 Andean Pact preceded Mercosur by over two decades, losing Chile in 1976 and Venezuela in 2006 while reorganizing as the Comunidad Andina in 1996 with its own parliament and court.

lessons.title: Comercio y cooperación
lessons.goal: Read how NAFTA (1994) boosted Mexican export manufacturing while squeezing small corn farmers against subsidized US imports, alongside the 1994 Group of Three and the region's growing "spaghetti bowl" of overlapping trade deals.

lessons.title: Una región unida
lessons.goal: Read a closing assessment of Latin American integration by 2000 -- consolidated blocs and lasting institutions, against still-modest intra-regional trade and Bolívar's still-unrealized dream, plus a forward look to 2008's UNASUR.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 32 Consolidation
lessons.goal: Consolidate language for regional integration, trade, cooperation, opportunities and limitations.

units.title: The End of the Cold War

lessons.goal: Read how the November 1989 fall of the Berlin Wall and the December 1989 Malta Summit, where Bush and Gorbachov jointly declared the Cold War over, marked a turning point that would reach Latin America too.

lessons.title: Un nuevo mundo

lessons.title: Nuevas prioridades
lessons.goal: Read how US policy toward Latin America shifted from a single anti-communist axis to trade, counter-narcotics, and democracy promotion -- Bush's June 1990 Enterprise for the Americas Initiative and the 1989 Andean Initiative.

lessons.title: América Latina después de la Guerra Fría
lessons.goal: Read how Cuba's loss of Soviet subsidies triggered the 1991 "Special Period", a roughly one-third economic contraction, the 1994 balsero migration crisis, and Castro's limited economic openings without political change.

lessons.title: Hacia los años noventa
lessons.goal: Read a closing synthesis of this unit's three storylines -- the global system's 1989-1991 collapse, Washington's reordered priorities, and Cuba's crisis -- and the transformed international framework the region entered the 1990s within.

lessons.label: Review

lessons.goal: Consolidate language for global change, the post-Cold War order, political and economic priorities, regional consequences and transition.

lessons.title: Los años de Menem

lessons.title: Fujimori y Perú

lessons.title: México y el TLCAN

lessons.goal: Read about the political shocks of 1994 -- the Zapatista uprising, the assassination of Luis Donaldo Colosio, and the peso crisis that followed NAFTA's entry into force.

lessons.title: Democracia y mercado
lessons.goal: Read about the regional pattern of elected leaders concentrating power to push market reforms, O'Donnell's "delegative democracy," and the contrasting case of Collor de Mello's impeachment.

lessons.title: Una década de contrastes
lessons.goal: Read a closing synthesis of the 1990s' uneven outcomes -- Chile's stability, the crises elsewhere, and the persistent inequality that CEPAL documented across the region.

lessons.label: Review

lessons.goal: Consolidate language for Latin American politics, economic reforms, regional integration, democracy and social contrasts in the 1990s.

lessons.title: Revolución y reforma
lessons.goal: Read about two paths of twentieth-century change -- Bolivia's 1952 National Revolution and Costa Rica's 1948 civil war that led to abolishing its army.

lessons.title: Dictadura y democracia
lessons.goal: Read about Brazil's 1988 Constitution and Colombia's 1991 Constitution as tools used to expand rights rather than concentrate power, in contrast to how other leaders used constitutional reform.

lessons.title: Desigualdad y desarrollo
lessons.goal: Read about Mexico's 1997 Progresa program -- a conditional cash transfer designed by Santiago Levy and rigorously evaluated -- as a response to inequality that outlasted decades of shifting development models.

lessons.title: Identidad y memoria
lessons.goal: Read about Argentina's official 1984 "Nunca Más" report and Brazil's clandestine "Brasil: Nunca Mais" project, and how two very different processes arrived at the same formula.

lessons.title: ¿Qué dejó el siglo XX?
lessons.goal: Read a closing synthesis of the unit's four themes -- paths of change, the double-edged use of constitutions, unresolved inequality, and shared memory -- as the region entered the new millennium.

lessons.goal: Consolidate language for twentieth-century political change, authoritarianism, development, historical memory and legacy.

lessons.title: Una región transformada

lessons.title: Política
lessons.goal: Read about Ecuador's January 2000 crisis -- Mahuad's dollarization announcement, the CONAIE-backed takeover of Congress, and Noboa's unexpected decision to keep the dollarization in place.

lessons.title: Economía y globalización
lessons.goal: Read about remittances as a quietly massive economic force by 2000 -- especially in El Salvador, where they rivaled traditional exports as a source of national income.

lessons.title: Sociedad e identidad
lessons.goal: Read about the region's demographic transformation into the developing world's most urbanized region by 2000 -- rising urban population, sprawling megacities, and informal settlements.

lessons.title: América Latina al entrar en el nuevo siglo

lessons.grammar: discurso constitucional analítico, ponderación de opciones de estatus y léxico de soberanía insular
lessons.goal: Analyze the constitutional nature of the Commonwealth (ELA), pro-statehood and pro-independence ideologies, and the PROMESA fiscal board using political and legal registers.

lessons.title: De la bomba y plena a la revolución global de la música urbana
lessons.grammar: crítica musicológica contemporánea, genealogía de ritmos afrodiaspóricos y léxico de la música urbana
lessons.goal: Examine Afro-Boricua musical traditions (bomba, plena), the New York salsa revolution (Fania), and contemporary urban music (reggaeton, Bad Bunny) using musicological criticism.

lessons.title: El huracán María, la crisis de la deuda y la resistencia ciudadana
lessons.grammar: discurso sobre catástrofes climáticas, movilización ciudadana y léxico de resiliencia comunitaria
lessons.goal: Analyze the devastation of Hurricane María, community self-management, and the historic Summer of 2019 civic uprising using sociological and political discourse.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Unit 12 Consolidation: Puerto Rico
lessons.grammar: síntesis discursiva sobre Puerto Rico: ecosistemas insulares, soberanía colonial, genealogía musical y poder ciudadano
lessons.goal: Consolidate Puerto Rican biodiversity, 1898 colonial history, musical evolution (bomba to reggaeton), and civic resistance through advanced purpose, concessive, and restrictive discourse.

lessons.title: Búsqueda de perfiles y antecedentes inespecíficos
lessons.grammar: oraciones de relativo con antecedente inespecífico o hipotético en subjuntivo
lessons.goal: Master the use of the subjunctive in relative clauses describing non-specific or hypothetical entities.

lessons.title: Antecedentes negativos e inexistencia categórica
lessons.grammar: oraciones de relativo con antecedentes negativos (nadie, nada, ninguno) y modo subjuntivo
lessons.goal: Express non-existence, absence, and refutation using negative antecedents with subjunctive relative clauses.

lessons.title: Alternancia modal: Lo concreto frente a lo hipotético
lessons.grammar: contraste de modo indicativo y subjuntivo en oraciones de relativo según la especificidad del antecedente
lessons.goal: Master the nuanced contrast between indicative (specific real entities) and subjunctive (hypothetical, searched entities) in relative clauses.

lessons.title: Relativas preposicionales y canales institucionales
lessons.grammar: relativas preposicionales complejas (con quien, mediante el cual, en el que) con subjuntivo
lessons.goal: Construct complex prepositional relative clauses with subjunctive to establish prospective procedures and institutional channels.

lessons.title: Criterios institucionales y cláusulas generalizadoras
lessons.grammar: relativas generalizadoras y distributivas en textos normativos con modo subjuntivo
lessons.goal: Apply the subjunctive in generalizing relative clauses ('cualquiera que', 'todo aquel que') within institutional statutes and regulatory texts.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Consolidación: Criterios, perfiles y la búsqueda de horizontes
lessons.grammar: repaso integral de oraciones de relativo en subjuntivo con antecedentes hipotéticos, negativos y estatutarios
lessons.goal: Consolidate upper-intermediate mastery of relative clauses with unidentified, negative, and generalizing antecedents in institutional and literary registers.

units.title: Colombia I: The Andean Core, Coffee & Realism

lessons.title: Las tres cordilleras y la geografía fractal colombiana
lessons.grammar: discurso biogeográfico andino y oraciones de relieve topográfico
lessons.goal: Analyze Colombia's tri-cordillera geography, paramo ecosystems, and high-altitude water sources using biogeographical terminology.

lessons.title: Bogotá: Atenas suramericana, TransMilenio y debate público
lessons.grammar: análisis de políticas cívicas y discurso sociológico urbano
lessons.goal: Explore Bogotá's intellectual heritage, civic culture transformations, and urban transit dilemmas through formal sociological discourse.

lessons.title: Medellín y el Paisa: De la crisis a la innovación social
lessons.grammar: narrativa de resiliencia comunitaria y urbanismo social
lessons.goal: Examine Medellín's transformation from violence to a global beacon of social urbanism, cable-transit integration, and paisa entrepreneurial resilience.

lessons.title: El Eje Cafetero y el paisaje cultural patrimonio
lessons.grammar: discurso etnobotánico, agronómico y valoración del patrimonio cultural
lessons.goal: Discover the UNESCO Coffee Cultural Landscape, traditional bahareque architecture, manual harvesting, and the Cocora Valley wax palms.

lessons.title: Gabriel García Márquez y el Realismo Mágico como lente social
lessons.grammar: crítica literaria, mediación testimonial y narrativa del realismo mágico
lessons.goal: Analyze García Márquez's literary legacy, journalistic roots, and the use of Magical Realism to address historical memory and social injustice in Colombia.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Consolidación: La espina dorsal andina y el alma colombiana
lessons.grammar: repaso integral del discurso biogeográfico, social y literario del corazón andino colombiano
lessons.goal: Consolidate communicative and cultural mastery of the Colombian Andean region, integrating cordillera geography, civic debate, social urbanism, coffee heritage, and literary realism.

lessons.title: Relativas universales con indefinidos en -quiera
lessons.grammar: oraciones relativas y concesivas universales: quienquiera que, cualquiera que, dondequiera que con subjuntivo
lessons.goal: Master the use of universal and concessive relative pronouns in -quiera with subjunctive to state categorical principles.

lessons.title: Concesivas intensivas con por más que y por muy
lessons.grammar: oraciones concesivas intensivas y de gradación extrema con modo subjuntivo e indicativo
lessons.goal: Deploy intensive concessive structures ('por más que', 'por mucho que', 'por muy + adj + que') with subjunctive in debate and policy analysis.

lessons.title: Subjuntivo reduplicado y fórmulas de indiferencia retórica
lessons.grammar: estructuras reduplicadas con subjuntivo: pase lo que pase, diga lo que diga, sea como sea
lessons.goal: Master reduplicated subjunctive structures of indifference ('haga lo que haga', 'cueste lo que cueste') in asserting unwavering principles.

lessons.title: Cuantificadores relativos universales: cuanto y todo aquel que
lessons.grammar: cuantificadores relativos universales (cuanto/a/os/as, todo aquel que) en subjuntivo e indicativo
lessons.goal: Master the use of universal quantifiers ('cuanto', 'todo aquel que', 'todo cuanto') in formulating inclusive legal and constitutional frameworks.

lessons.title: Generalizaciones éticas y mandatos constitucionales
lessons.grammar: generalizaciones categóricas y sentenciosas en el discurso jurídico y constitucional
lessons.goal: Apply universal relative clauses and generalizing subjunctive structures to formulate binding constitutional and human rights principles.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Consolidación: Universalidad, principios inmutables y la selva devoradora
lessons.grammar: repaso integral de relativas universales (-quiera), concesivas de gradación extrema y fórmulas de determinación
lessons.goal: Consolidate upper-intermediate mastery of universal relatives, intensive concessives, and reduplicated subjunctive structures in philosophical and classical literary discourse.

units.title: Colombia II: The Caribbean, Pacific, Afro-Colombian Heritage & Peace

lessons.title: Cartagena y la costa Caribe: Fortificaciones, San Basilio de Palenque y cumbia
lessons.grammar: narrativa histórica del cimarronaje y patrimonio afrocaribeño
lessons.goal: Explore Cartagena's colonial fortifications, the maroon revolution of San Basilio de Palenque, and the Afro-Caribbean musical heritage.

lessons.title: El Pacífico colombiano: Biodiversidad selvática, marimba y currulao
lessons.grammar: discurso ecológico y musical del litoral Pacífico colombiano
lessons.goal: Analyze the biogeographical uniqueness of the Colombian Pacific, the craftsmanship of the chonta marimba, and the communal power of currulao.

lessons.title: Las comunidades afrodescendientes e indígenas: La Ley 70 de 1993
lessons.grammar: discurso de derecho constitucional étnico, propiedad colectiva y consulta previa
lessons.goal: Understand Colombia's ethnic constitutional framework, collective land titles under Law 70 of 1993, and prior consultation jurisprudence.

lessons.title: El conflicto armado y el largo camino hacia la paz
lessons.grammar: discurso de justicia transicional, resolución de conflictos y memoria histórica
lessons.goal: Examine Colombia's 2016 Peace Accords, transitional restorative justice (JEP), the Truth Commission, and victims' leadership in historical memory.

lessons.title: Transición ecológica, Amazonia colombiana y nuevo liderazgo
lessons.grammar: discurso ecológico, diplomacia climática y patrimonio arqueológico amazónico
lessons.goal: Explore the Serranía de Chiribiquete, pre-Columbian rock art, Amazonian conservation, and Colombia's global climate diplomacy.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Consolidación: Una nación pluriétnica: Territorios de resistencia y esperanza
lessons.grammar: repaso integral de la diversidad pluriétnica, derechos colectivos y memoria histórica de Colombia
lessons.goal: Consolidate communicative and cultural mastery of Colombia's peripheral regions, integrating Caribbean maroon heritage, Pacific marimba traditions, Law 70 collective rights, peacebuilding, and Amazonian ecology.

lessons.title: Las dos formas del imperfecto de subjuntivo: -ra y -se
lessons.grammar: morfología comparada del imperfecto de subjuntivo en -ra y -se
lessons.goal: Master the morphological distinction, historical origins, and equivalence between the -ra and -se forms of the imperfect subjunctive.

lessons.title: Contraste de registro estilístico entre -ra y -se
lessons.grammar: distribución de registro y frecuencia dialectal de -ra y -se en el mundo hispánico
lessons.goal: Analyze sociolinguistic frequency and stylistic distribution: overwhelming preference for -ra in Latin America versus judicial/protocolar uses of -se.

lessons.title: Fórmulas de cortesía y atenuación con imperfecto de subjuntivo
lessons.grammar: subjuntivo atenuador de cortesía con verbos modales en cláusulas independientes
lessons.goal: Deploy modal imperfect subjunctive forms (quisiera, debiera, pudiera) in independent clauses to soften requests and express polite deference.

lessons.title: Hipótesis irreales y deseos presentes con 'como si' y 'ojalá'
lessons.grammar: oraciones comparativas irreales (como si) y desiderativas presentes (ojalá)
lessons.goal: Formulate counterfactual present hypotheses and low-probability wishes using 'como si' and 'ojalá' with imperfect subjunctive.

lessons.title: El uso estilístico de -ra con valor de indicativo en la prosa formal
lessons.grammar: uso estilístico etimológico de -ra con valor de pretérito o pluscuamperfecto de indicativo
lessons.goal: Recognize and interpret the stylistic use of the -ra form with past indicative value in journalistic, historiographical, and literary prose.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Consolidación: El imperfecto de subjuntivo y Doña Bárbara
lessons.grammar: síntesis del imperfecto de subjuntivo: alternancia -ra/-se, cortesía, contrafácticos y valor periodístico
lessons.goal: Synthesize all aspects of the imperfect subjunctive through classical literary analysis of Rómulo Gallegos's Doña Bárbara.

units.title: Venezuela I: The Oil Century, Modernism & Caracas

lessons.title: La cordillera de la Costa y el valle de Caracas
lessons.grammar: geografía orográfica, toponimia indígena y fisonomía urbana caraqueña
lessons.goal: Examine the physical geography of Caracas, the tectonic coastal range, and the tutelary presence of El Ávila (Waraira Repano).

lessons.title: El pozo Zumaque I y el nacimiento del petroestado
lessons.grammar: historiografía económica de los hidrocarburos y teoría del petroestado
lessons.goal: Investigate the historic oil strikes of Zumaque I (1914) and Los Barrosos II (1922) and the emergence of the rentier state in Venezuela.

lessons.title: Carlos Raúl Villanueva y la Ciudad Universitaria: Utopía moderna
lessons.grammar: análisis arquitectónico, acústica de vanguardia y patrimonio moderno de la UNESCO
lessons.goal: Explore Carlos Raúl Villanueva's modernist masterpiece (UCV) and the concept of the Synthesis of Major Arts.

lessons.title: El cinetismo y las vanguardias plásticas: Cruz-Diez y Soto
lessons.grammar: teoría estética del arte cinético, percepción óptica y pedagogía musical orquestal
lessons.goal: Analyze the Venezuelan kinetic art movement of Carlos Cruz-Diez and Jesús Rafael Soto, alongside José Antonio Abreu's El Sistema.

lessons.title: La bonanza petrolera y las ilusiones del 'Dakar' suramericano
lessons.grammar: economía del auge de recursos, sociología del consumo y modismos venezolanos
lessons.goal: Examine the 1970s petrodollar boom ('Venezuela Saudita'), consumerism, the Dutch disease, and the 1983 Black Friday collapse.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Consolidación: La modernidad petrolera venezolana
lessons.grammar: síntesis de estudios regionales venezolanos: petroestado, arquitectura moderna y cinetismo
lessons.goal: Consolidate regional studies on Venezuela's oil century: modernist architecture, kinetic art, youth orchestras, and rentier political economy.

lessons.title: Morfología del pluscuamperfecto de subjuntivo
lessons.grammar: morfología del pluscuamperfecto de subjuntivo: haber (hubiera/hubiese) + participio
lessons.goal: Master the morphological structure, auxiliary alternation (hubiera/hubiese), and anteriority value of the pluperfect subjunctive.

lessons.title: Deseos retrospectivos y lamentos pasados con '¡Ojalá!'
lessons.grammar: oraciones desiderativas retrospectivas independientes con ¡Ojalá! y pluscuamperfecto de subjuntivo
lessons.goal: Deploy '¡Ojalá!' followed by pluperfect subjunctive to express retrospective past wishes, regrets, and unfulfilled nostalgic longings.

lessons.title: Estructuras condicionales contrafácticas con 'de haber + participio'
lessons.grammar: estructuras condicionales contrafácticas implícitas con de haber + participio
lessons.goal: Deploy abbreviated counterfactual conditional structures with 'de haber + participio' in formal, academic, and journalistic registers.

lessons.title: Juicios retrospectivos y alternativas históricas en el debate crítico
lessons.grammar: fórmulas modales de evaluación retrospectiva: más hubiera valido, habríamos debido, bien pudiera haber sido
lessons.goal: Formulate retrospective evaluations, historical alternatives, and counterfactual critique in intellectual essays and political discourse.

lessons.title: Matices estilísticos de 'hubiese' en la prosa literaria y ensayística
lessons.grammar: estilística narrativa y eufonía de la variante auxiliar en -se en la prosa culta
lessons.goal: Analyze the stylistic nuances, euphonic cadence, and literary prestige of the 'hubiese' variant in artistic and reflective prose.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Consolidación: El pluscuamperfecto de subjuntivo e Ifigenia
lessons.grammar: síntesis del pluscuamperfecto de subjuntivo: deseos pasados, de haber + participio y juicio crítico
lessons.goal: Synthesize all aspects of the pluperfect subjunctive through classical psychological and feminist analysis of Teresa de la Parra's Ifigenia.

units.title: Venezuela II: The Llanos, Tepuis & Modern Diaspora

lessons.title: Los Llanos del Orinoco: Joropo, ganado y poesía llanera
lessons.grammar: geografía de los Llanos, cantos de vaquería de la UNESCO y organología del joropo
lessons.goal: Explore the vast savannas of Apure and Barinas, cattle culture, UNESCO intangible cattle work songs, and joropo music.

lessons.title: La Gran Sabana, Canaima y el reino de los tepuyes
lessons.grammar: geología precámbrica del Escudo Guayanés, cosmovisión Pemón e hidrografía de cataratas
lessons.goal: Investigate the Precambrian geology of Canaima National Park, sacred Pemón tepui plateaus, and Angel Falls (Kerepakupai Vená).

lessons.title: La crisis macroeconómica, la hiperinflación y el colapso del modelo rentista
lessons.grammar: economía política de la crisis, hiperinflación contemporánea y resiliencia social
lessons.goal: Examine the contemporary socioeconomic crisis in Venezuela: oil production collapse, hyperinflation, de facto dollarization, and civic resilience.

lessons.title: El éxodo venezolano: La mayor migración en la historia de América Latina
lessons.grammar: sociología de las migraciones forzadas, rutas transcontinentales y derecho humanitario
lessons.goal: Examine the continental displacement of over 7 million Venezuelans, the ordeal of the 'caminantes', and Colombia's landmark Temporary Protection Statute.

lessons.title: La diáspora y la reinvención de la identidad venezolana en el exterior
lessons.grammar: antropología de la diáspora, diplomacia culinaria y patrimonio inmaterial transcontinental
lessons.goal: Analyze the transcontinental reinvention of Venezuelan identity abroad: global arepa diplomacy, music, and professional integration.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Consolidación: Paisajes inmemoriales y diáspora viva
lessons.grammar: síntesis de estudios regionales venezolanos: llanos, tepuyes de Canaima y diáspora transcontinental
lessons.goal: Consolidate regional studies on Venezuela's southern territories, cattle culture, ancient tepuis, macroeconomic transitions, and transcontinental diaspora.

lessons.title: El estilo indirecto con verbo principal en pasado: traslación de asertos
lessons.grammar: el estilo indirecto con verbo principal en pasado: traslación temporal de asertos
lessons.goal: Master the backshifting of statements from direct to indirect discourse with past reporting verbs.

lessons.title: Preguntas indirectas y traslación interrogativa en pasado

lessons.goal: Report yes/no questions and information questions in past frames using 'si' and interrogative pronouns.

lessons.title: Órdenes, ruegos y peticiones referidas: del imperativo al subjuntivo

lessons.goal: Report direct commands, requests, and prohibitions by shifting imperatives to the imperfect subjunctive.

lessons.title: Traslación de deícticos temporales, espaciales y demostrativos
lessons.grammar: traslación deíctica temporal y espacial en el discurso referido
lessons.goal: Systematically shift temporal, spatial, and demonstrative deictic markers in past reported speech frames.

lessons.title: El discurso indirecto libre en la prosa narrativa hispanoamericana
lessons.grammar: el discurso indirecto libre en la prosa narrativa hispanoamericana
lessons.goal: Analyze and deploy free indirect discourse in literary narratives, blending narrator voice and character consciousness.

lessons.label: Review

lessons.grammar: síntesis del discurso referido en el pasado y adaptación literaria de Huasipungo
lessons.goal: Synthesize reported speech backshifting, indirect questions, requests, and free indirect discourse through Jorge Icaza's indigenist classic Huasipungo.

units.title: Ecuador: Plurinationalism, The Equatorial Andes & The Galápagos

lessons.title: La avenida de los volcanes y el callejón interandino
lessons.grammar: geomorfología volcánica del callejón interandino, pisos ecológicos y ciudades patrimoniales
lessons.goal: Explore the volcanic geography of the Ecuadorian Andes, Humboldt's exploration of Chimborazo, and colonial Quito and Cuenca.

lessons.title: El archipiélago de Galápagos: Laboratorio de la evolución
lessons.grammar: biogeografía insular, especiación por selección natural y reservas marinas oceánicas
lessons.goal: Investigate the unique evolutionary adaptations of Galapagos wildlife, Charles Darwin's historic visit, and oceanic marine reserves.

lessons.title: La CONAIE y la fuerza histórica del movimiento indígena
lessons.grammar: sociología del movimiento indígena, Estado Plurinacional y democracia intercultural
lessons.goal: Examine the political rise of the indigenous movement in Ecuador, the 1990 nationwide uprising, and the Pachakutik movement.

lessons.title: La Constitución de Montecristi: Pachamama y Derechos de la Naturaleza
lessons.grammar: derechos de la naturaleza, constitucionalismo biocéntrico y filosofía del Sumak Kawsay
lessons.goal: Explore the groundbreaking 2008 Montecristi Constitution recognizing Nature as a legal subject under the Sumak Kawsay principle.

lessons.title: El petróleo amazónico, Yasuní-ITT y la consulta popular
lessons.grammar: ecología política amazónica, pueblos en aislamiento voluntario y democracia ambiental directa
lessons.goal: Examine the biodiversity of Yasuni National Park, uncontacted peoples (Tagaeri/Taromenane), and the landmark 2023 popular referendum.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Consolidación Regional: Ecuador, la síntesis de los cuatro mundos
lessons.grammar: síntesis de estudios regionales ecuatorianos: volcanes, Galápagos, CONAIE y Derechos de la Naturaleza
lessons.goal: Consolidate regional studies on Ecuador's four worlds, Andean volcanoes, Galapagos evolution, indigenous plurinationalism, and biocentric jurisprudence.

lessons.title: Verbos declarativos y aseverativos formales
lessons.grammar: verbos declarativos y aseverativos formales en el registro periodístico y académico
lessons.goal: Deploy assertive and declarative reporting verbs (aseverar, sostener, recalcar) to specify conviction and formal attribution.

lessons.title: Verbos de disputa, refutación y réplica dialéctica
lessons.grammar: verbos de controversia dialéctica, refutación argumentativa y desmentido institucional
lessons.goal: Master verbs of dispute, refutation, and legal challenge (desmentir, refutar, impugnar, rebatir) in debate.

lessons.title: Verbos de advertencia, prevención y recordatorio
lessons.grammar: verbos de advertencia, precaución institucional y recordatorio legal
lessons.goal: Deploy communication verbs of warning, risk anticipation, and legal reminders (advertir, alertar, conminar).

lessons.title: Verbos de reproche, censura y evaluación crítica
lessons.grammar: verbos de reproche ético, censura institucional y cuestionamiento crítico
lessons.goal: Express retrospective moral censure, critique, and ethical reproach using specialized reporting verbs (reprochar, censurar).

lessons.title: Verbos de conjetura, sospecha y distanciamiento epistémico

lessons.goal: Employ journalistic distancing verbs (alegar, conjeturar, insinuar) to report claims without committing to their truth value.

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Consolidación B2: Verbos retóricos y El mundo es ancho y ajeno

lessons.goal: Synthesize rhetorical reporting verbs of assertion, refutation, warning, and critique through Ciro Alegría's indigenist masterpiece El mundo es ancho y ajeno.

units.title: Peru I: Cusco, Tawantinsuyu & Andean Worldview

lessons.title: La cordillera Blanca y los glaciares andinos

lessons.goal: Explore the high-altitude geography of the Cordillera Blanca, the Huascarán peak, and tropical glacial hydrology.

lessons.title: Civilizaciones preincas: Caral, Chavín y Moche

lessons.title: Tawantinsuyu y la red vial del Qhapaq Ñan

lessons.title: Cusco colonial y la Escuela Cusqueña de pintura
lessons.grammar: barroco virreinal andino, Escuela Cusqueña de pintura y sincretismo de la Pachamama
lessons.goal: Explore the architectural palimpsest of Cusco, the indigenous painters' guild of Diego Quispe Tito, and religious syncretism.

lessons.title: El quechua hoy: vitalidad lingüística y literatura andina

lessons.label: Review
lessons.title: Consolidación Regional: El ombligo del mundo y los Andes peruanos
lessons.grammar: síntesis de estudios regionales del Perú andino: Tawantinsuyu, Qhapaq Ñan y Escuela Cusqueña
lessons.goal: Consolidate regional studies on Andean Peru: Cordillera Blanca glaciation, pre-Inca foundations, Tawantinsuyu statecraft, Cusqueño syncretism, and Quechua vitality.

lessons.title: Pasiva refleja básica y concordancia de número

lessons.title: Pasiva refleja frente a impersonal con se

lessons.goal: Distinguish reflexive passives with plural inanimate subjects from strictly impersonal 'se' clauses introducing animate patients with 'a'.

lessons.title: Restricciones de agentividad en la pasiva refleja
lessons.grammar: restricciones de agentividad implícita y omisión del complemento agente en la pasiva refleja
lessons.goal: Examine semantic agency constraints and agent omission in reflexive passive clauses versus analytical passives.

lessons.title: El se en el discurso administrativo y legal

lessons.goal: Deploy the impersonal and reflexive 'se' in decrees, judicial rulings, minutes, and administrative edicts.

lessons.title: Desambiguación pragmática de las funciones de se

lessons.label: Review

lessons.goal: Synthesize reflexive passive and impersonal 'se' structures through Mario Vargas Llosa's military academy masterpiece La ciudad y los perros.

units.title: Peru II: The Pacific Coast, Lima & The Gastronomic Vanguard
